english.title: Remove / tamper with a seal / lock / mark used to identify goods under Community requirements
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[wilfully and prematurely removed a seal securing or identifying goods,]_
(B)_[wilfully and prematurely tampered with a seal securing or identifying goods,]_
(C)_[wilfully and prematurely removed a lock securing goods,]_
(D)_[wilfully and prematurely tampered with a lock securing goods,]_
(E)_[wilfully and prematurely removed a mark identifying goods,]_
(F)_[wilfully and prematurely tampered with a mark identifying goods,]_
(G)_[were in charge of goods secured or identified by a seal which was wilfully and prematurely removed,]_
(H)_[were in charge of goods secured or identified by a seal which was wilfully and prematurely tampered with,]_
(I)_[were in charge of goods secured by a lock which was wilfully and prematurely removed,]_
(J)_[were in charge of goods secured by a lock which was wilfully and prematurely tampered with,]_
(K)_[were in charge of goods identified by a mark which was wilfully and prematurely removed,]_
(L)_[were in charge of goods identified by a mark which was wilfully and prematurely tampered with,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..),the

(M)_[seal]_
(N)_[lock]_
(O)_[mark]_

being used to secure or identify those goods for customs and excise purposes in pursuance of

(P)_[a community requirement or practice relating to the movement of goods between countries]_
(Q)_[an international agreement to which the United Kingdom was a party]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 83(3) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:

(I)_[fod yn gyfrifol am nwyddau wedi eu diogelu gan glo a gafodd ei dynnu]_
(J)_[fod yn gyfrifol am nwyddau wedi eu diogelu gan glo a ymyrrwyd ag ef yn fwriadol ac yn rhy gynnar]_

a bod y

(M)_[sêl]_
(N)_[clo]_
(O)_[marc]_

yn cael ei ddefnyddio i ddiogelu neu adnabod y nwyddau hynny ar gyfer pwrpasau tollau tramor a chartref yn unol â
